notes.title: Patch Notes - v031 - Day 2!
notes.content:
Hey! Excited to get back here on day 2.

Here is the Patch notes for v031. I wanna thank the community for bringing those issues to me so promptly. <3

- [Improvement] Hold mouse button (or controller button) to attack
- [BUG] Skeleton and golem defense reduced, player always hits at least 1 damage.
- [BUG] Fixed when damage label sometimes appeared far away from the enemy
- [BUG] Fixed sword animation and speed
- [BUG] Removed elements from the environment that looked liked they could be interacted. This will in the future return as a new feature.
- [BUG] Sometimes a dropped item could prevent player to traverse over it. It's now fixed.

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes v030
notes.content:
Hey guys! First day! Excited to put the game out for you to play.

- Updated the music to a more extended version.
- Fix a bug where sometimes a lack of controller input would broke the game.
- Reduced the time you need to wait for an Item to be dropped after the enemy was killed.

Thank you for understanding! Cheers
Have fun!
